title: [review] provisioning.py:435: Session expiration happens aft
description: In create_br_session(), the check `len(self._sessions) >= self._max_sessions` (line 435) happens BEFORE `_expire_sessions()` is called (line 440). This means if sessions have expired but not yet been cleaned up, the check will reject new sessions unnecessarily. The same bug exists in create_node_session() at line 477 vs 482. The expiration should happen before the capacity check.
close_reason: Fixed: moved _expire_sessions() before max_sessions capacity check in both create_br_session() and create_node_session() methods. This ensures expired sessions are cleaned up before checking capacity, preventing unnecessary rejection of new sessions.
